args.script:
cat > solution.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
DIR="$1"
EXT="$2"
find "$DIR" -type f -name "*.$EXT" -exec du -b {} \; | awk '{sum += $1} END {print sum}'
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
